name: heartfelt
prompt:
Heartfelt, warm vertical family film featuring the exact {vehicle} shown in the reference photos: {look}. Keep the vehicle's design, proportions, badges and wheels identical to the references.
Compose every shot with the vehicle in the upper two thirds of the frame and plain ground or floor in the lower third. The whole vehicle stays fully visible in exterior shots, never cropped.
The very first frame is already in motion, no slow fade in.
Shot 1 (0-2s): a young child sprints through golden grass toward the parked vehicle, arms out, seen from behind at child height, camera racing low right behind them, the full vehicle waiting ahead at {scenery}, sun flaring past it.
Shot 2 (2-5s): wide shot, a parent catches up, takes the child's hand and they walk the last steps to the vehicle together, seen from behind, warm backlight, grass moving in the breeze.
Shot 3 (5-7.5s): wide interior view from the rear of the cabin looking forward across the seats and dashboard, matching the interior reference, sunset glowing through the windshield, a child's small backpack on the seat.
Shot 4 (7.5-10s): wide hero shot from behind as the vehicle drives away along an open road through that same landscape toward the sunset, the vehicle large and clearly visible in the upper middle of the frame.
Photoreal, natural warm colour, emotional. No on-screen text, no captions, no subtitles, no labels, no logos other than those on the vehicle, no license plate text. Audio: realistic sound effects only: running footsteps in grass, a child's laugh, breeze, a soft door close, tyres on the road. Absolutely no music, no voices speaking.
